new_judgments.n: Continuing AI-first corporate direction, without a concrete application.
Centralized frontier-model R&D organizational resources; no actual pilot or distinct deployment.
Section heading alone has no independently interpretable claim.
Explicit full-stack responsible AI strategic objective; no concrete intended task.
Currently offered TPU/GPU AI compute infrastructure; provider scope rather than internal workflow adoption.

new_judgments.n: Gemini 3 currently integrates multimodal reasoning into Search and Gemini app; model-level product evidence.
Current cross-product Gemini integration; reported user/product counts are deployment scale, not realized outcomes.
new_judgments.use: Gemini integration across product portfolio; distinct tasks unspecified

new_judgments.n: Responsible AI principles and explicit corporate development direction.
Current paid autonomous Waymo ride-hailing in multiple cities; AI context established by parent.
Isomorphic Labs reports applying AI to drug development; present R&D workflow use, with experimental boundaries unclear.
Explicit long-term AI product investment direction does not specify an intended application.
Search currently provides AI Overviews and AI Mode responses using Gemini; combined search task avoids feature double counting.
new_judgments.use: Google Search AI responses and reasoning

new_judgments.n: Current Pixel device family expresses AI/software/hardware offering, but individual AI tasks not disclosed.
Currently named advertising AI product suite finds conversion opportunities; suite counted once at disclosed task granularity.
new_judgments.use: Demand Gen / Performance Max / Product Studio advertising AI suite

new_judgments.n: Currently offered AI accelerator and software infrastructure; same Cloud compute application as earlier disclosure.
new_judgments.use: Google Cloud AI training and serving compute

new_judgments.n: Vertex AI currently delivers a managed custom model and agent development platform; 200 models is scale.
new_judgments.use: Vertex AI custom model and agent development
